name: Patch
lore: A forgotten arcade controller awakened by Crossroads magic. Never travels without a player two.

primary.name: D-Pad Volley
primary.description: Fire four bolts in a cross: one toward your aim, one behind and one to each side. Each deals 14 damage.

secondary.name: Reset Pulse
secondary.description: Send a short expanding pulse for 18 damage and erase hostile projectiles within 135 units.

special.name: Player Two
special.description: Summon two targetable 45-HP Bit Buddies for 9s (11s with passive). Each deals 10 damage per hit. Partners stay separated while following and attacking.

passive: Extra Credits: Bit Buddies stay for two additional seconds.

technique.name: Patient Partners
technique.description: Bit Buddies last 40% longer, but deal 25% less damage per hit.

final_technique.name: Patchwork Pincers
final_technique.description: Two sewn crescents return for 18 per leg. Replaces the close pulse wave with ranged timing; no projectile-clearing pulse.

attack.name: Patchwork Pincers
attack.description: Two sewn crescents return for 18 per leg. Replaces the close pulse wave with ranged timing; no projectile-clearing pulse.
